props.Description#316:164: Cook the rice following its package instructions. Trim the asparagus. Mix honey, sriracha, coconut aminos, lime juice, and garlic using the listed quantities.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook, turning as needed. Check the thickest part with a thermometer: chicken must reach 165°F / 74°C.
Cook the asparagus until tender. Coat the cooked chicken with the sauce and heat through. Serve over rice.

props.Description#316:167: Baking sheet, mixing bowl, knife and chopping board
Lemon and oregano chicken tucked into warm pita with crunchy vegetables, feta and a quick yogurt sauce.

props.Description#316:164: Heat the oven to 425°F / 220°C. Combine the listed chicken, olive oil, garlic, lemon, and oregano. Spread on a baking sheet without crowding.
Roast the chicken until a thermometer in the thickest part reads 165°F / 74°C. Meanwhile, chop the cucumber, tomato, and red onion. Mix the yogurt sauce using the recipe quantities.
Warm the pita. Fill with cooked chicken, vegetables, yogurt sauce, and feta. Keep unused components separate for leftovers.

props.Description#316:167: Large sauté pan, colander, knife and chopping board
A hearty pan of lentils, tomatoes and colourful vegetables, finished with fresh basil.

props.Description#316:164: Chop the onion, eggplant, zucchini, and bell pepper. Drain the canned lentils. Measure the garlic, oil, tomatoes, and herbs using the ingredient list.
Soften the onion in oil over medium heat. Add garlic, eggplant, zucchini, and pepper. Stir as the vegetables soften.
Add the canned tomatoes, lentils, and thyme. Simmer until the vegetables are tender and the mixture is hot throughout. Finish with basil and taste before serving.

props.Description#316:167: Saucepan, skillet, colander, knife and chopping board
Golden tofu and zucchini over spaghetti with a bright lemon, caper and parsley sauce.

props.Description#316:164: Drain the tofu and pat it dry. Cut the tofu and zucchini. Cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions, reserving some pasta water.
Heat the listed oil in a skillet over medium heat. Brown the tofu on both sides, then cook the zucchini until tender. Follow the tofu package’s preparation instructions.
Add garlic, stock, lemon, and capers. Simmer, then stir in butter and parsley. Toss with the spaghetti; loosen with reserved pasta water as needed.

props.Description#316:167: Skillet, toaster or grill, mixing bowl, knife and chopping board
Crisp toast piled with warm paprika chicken, chopped tomato, creamy yogurt and crumbled feta.

props.Description#316:164: Chop the tomato and parsley. Mix yogurt with lemon using the listed quantities. Toast the bread. Keep these ingredients separate from the raw chicken.
Heat the listed oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken with garlic and paprika, turning as needed, until the thickest part reaches 165°F / 74°C on a food thermometer.
Spread the toast with yogurt, then add the cooked chicken, tomato, feta, and parsley. Serve immediately. Store leftover components separately.
